recipes.title: Daiquiri
recipes.instructions: Shake the rum, lime juice, and sugar with ice until chilled. Fine-strain into a chilled coupe.
recipes.originalIngredients: 60 ml white Cuban rum,20 ml fresh lime juice,2 bar spoons superfine sugar
recipes.modifications: Retained factual ingredient quantities from the pinned source row. Ingredient names and recipe structure normalized for CocktAIls; SOUR style label assigned by CocktAIls; method newly authored. No source garnish was added.

recipes.title: Manhattan
recipes.instructions: Stir the whiskey, vermouth, and bitters with ice until very cold. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
recipes.originalIngredients: 50 ml Rye whiskey,20 ml Sweet red vermouth,1 dash Angostura bitters
recipes.modifications: Retained factual ingredient quantities from the pinned source row. Ingredient names and recipe structure normalized for CocktAIls; SHORT style label assigned by CocktAIls; method newly authored. No source garnish was added.

recipes.title: Margarita
recipes.instructions: Shake the tequila, triple sec, and lime juice with ice. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
recipes.originalIngredients: 50 ml tequila 100% agave,20 ml triple sec,15 ml freshly squeezed lime juice
recipes.modifications: Retained factual ingredient quantities from the pinned source row. Ingredient names and recipe structure normalized for CocktAIls; SOUR style label assigned by CocktAIls; method newly authored. No source garnish was added.

recipes.title: Dry Martini
recipes.instructions: Stir the gin and dry vermouth with ice until thoroughly chilled. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
recipes.originalIngredients: 60 ml (2.0 US fl oz) gin,10 ml (0.34 US fl oz) dry vermouth
recipes.modifications: Structured amounts use the source metric quantities. Ingredient names normalized; SHORT style label assigned by CocktAIls; method newly authored. No source garnish was added.

recipes.title: Negroni
recipes.instructions: Stir the gin, sweet vermouth, and bitter aperitif with ice. Strain over fresh ice in a rocks glass.
recipes.originalIngredients: 3 cl gin,3 cl sweet red vermouth,3 cl Campari
recipes.modifications: Retained source quantities as 3 cl per ingredient. BITTER style label assigned by CocktAIls; method newly authored. No source garnish was added.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned
recipes.instructions: Add the sugar cube and bitters to a rocks glass with a little water. Muddle to dissolve, add whiskey and ice, then stir until chilled.
recipes.originalIngredients: 45 ml bourbon or rye whiskey,1 sugar cube,Few dashes Angostura bitters,Few dashes plain water
recipes.modifications: Retained the source's alternative bourbon-or-rye whiskey, one sugar cube, few dashes of Angostura bitters, and few dashes of plain water. SHORT style label assigned by CocktAIls; method newly authored. No source garnish was added.

recipes.title: Sidecar
recipes.instructions: Shake the cognac, triple sec, and lemon juice with ice. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
recipes.originalIngredients: 5 cl cognac,2 cl triple sec,2 cl lemon juice
recipes.modifications: Retained source quantities of 5 cl cognac, 2 cl triple sec, and 2 cl lemon juice. SOUR style label assigned by CocktAIls; method newly authored. No source garnish was added.

recipes.title: Whiskey Sour
recipes.instructions: Shake the whiskey, lemon juice, and simple syrup with ice until chilled. Strain over fresh ice or into a chilled glass.
recipes.originalIngredients: 4.5 cl (3 parts) bourbon whiskey,3 cl (2 parts) fresh lemon juice,1.5 cl (1 part) simple syrup
recipes.modifications: Retained source quantities of 4.5 cl (3 parts) bourbon whiskey, 3 cl (2 parts) fresh lemon juice, and 1.5 cl (1 part) simple syrup. SOUR style label assigned by CocktAIls; method newly authored. No egg white or garnish was added because neither appears in the pinned row.
